title: POST /v1/scans request
description: Public scan request. The caller supplies a task name and one passage, and nothing else. There is deliberately no field for policy, mode, instructions, thresholds or trust level: every attempt to add one is a validation failure, because a caller must not be able to weaken its own scan.

content.description: Exactly one passage. This is an object, not an array, so a request carrying two passages cannot be expressed at all rather than being silently truncated to the first. Batch scanning, if ever added, gets its own endpoint.

text.description: The original passage, untrusted for its entire length. maxLength is a cheap character-count ceiling; byte-accurate and tokenizer-accurate limits are enforced ahead of this schema (C16, C20) because UTF-8 characters are not bytes and bytes are not tokens.
